notes: All decisions compared with the exact local definitions, source spans, countervailing qualifications and frozen critiques. Four material defects meet the threshold: prior neglect in comparative explanation, consensus overstatement, unequal reconstruction standards and recasting low probability as impossibility.

Absence of proof, uncertain historical reports, use of scholarly sources, conditional hypotheses and narrative silence alone do not warrant labels. The two revised decisions explicitly distinguish expected-but-absent evidence and a challenge to survey scope. No distribution quota or score modification.
